ctgov.note: No CDT/Conduit-sponsored trials registered on ctgov.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: CDT Equity (formerly Conduit Pharmaceuticals, renamed Aug 2025) operates a lean asset-repositioning model. Per FY2025 10-K, the company explicitly avoids late-stage clinical trial costs and focuses on in vitro / in vivo preclinical work guided by AI signature analysis (Sarborg partnership), seeking exit through third-party license deals. Lead assets AZD1656 and AZD5658 (HK-4 glucokinase activators, in-licensed from AstraZeneca Aug 2024) and AZD5904 (myeloperoxidase inhibitor for idiopathic male infertility) historically completed Phase 1 under AstraZeneca but are not in any CDT-sponsored active P1/P2/P3 trials.

excluded_preclinical.stage: Preclinical (in vitro / in vivo); historical Phase 1 completed under AstraZeneca
